description: Fetch a dataflow's metadata (name, full description, linked resources), dimensions, their order, and how to construct a query key. Returns per-dimension names, codelist references, and position in the dot-delimited key. Required before calling oecd_query_dataset to understand key structure.

flow_ref.description: Full flow reference, either {agencyID},{dsd_id}@{df_id} — e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD,DSD_NAAG@DF_NAAG_I" — or the bare {agencyID},{df_id} form OECD uses for the few dataflows published without a datastructure prefix. Obtain from oecd_search_datasets.

version.description: Published dataflow edition, for example 1.1. Omit to use the latest edition.

name: oecd_get_dataset_info

concept_lookup_failed_for.description: Dimensions affected by a failed concept-name lookup, including time when affected.

items.description: Dimension ID whose concept scheme could not be read.

description.description: Full dataflow abstract with valid HTTP, HTTPS, and mailto links preserved as Markdown [label](url). Omitted when OECD publishes no description.

items.description: A dataflow dimension with its key position and codelist reference.

codelist_ref.description: Codelist reference in the form {agencyID},{codelistID} — use with oecd_get_dimension_values.

name.description: Concept name for the dimension — e.g. "Reference area" for REF_AREA. Repeats the id when no concept name was resolved.

position.description: 1-based position in the dot-delimited key. Segment at this position corresponds to this dimension.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_flow_ref`: The flow_ref parameter matches neither the {agencyID},{dsd_id}@{df_id} nor the {agencyID},{df_id} format. `dataflow_not_found`: OECD publishes no dataflow under the provided flow_ref, or the dataflow resolves to no datastructure. `rate_limited`: OECD throttled the request rate and was still refusing after the retries, or asked for a wait longer than the call's upstream budget had left. `upstream_timeout`: An OECD request ran past OECD_TIMEOUT_MS, or the call's requests and retries together ran past its upstream budget — 50 seconds, or OECD_TIMEOUT_MS when that is longer. `upstream_unavailable`: OECD returned a server fault or was unreachable once the retries ran out. `upstream_redirect`: The configured OECD host answered with a redirect, which this server never follows. `upstream_error`: OECD refused the request with a status this server does not model — an authorization challenge, a rejection from something sitting in front of the API, a request read as malformed or unprocessable (HTTP 400 or 422), or a method it does not implement (HTTP 501). `upstream_unreadable`: OECD answered with a body this server could not read — not JSON, or JSON whose fields do not have the shape SDMX gives them. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

key_example.description: Example dot-delimited key with wildcards — each dot corresponds to one dimension in position order. Empty segments are wildcards. Replace with actual codes from oecd_get_dimension_values.

name.description: Human-readable dataflow name. Omitted when the upstream response carries no dataflow entry.

published_versions.description: Published editions when the OECD edition catalog could be read.

resources.description: External resources from the dataflow EXT_RESOURCE annotations. Omitted when none are present.

items.description: An external resource published on the dataflow (methodology document, boundary file, or bulk download).

url.description: Target http or https URL for the linked resource.

time_dimension.description: Time dimension — used for start_period/end_period filtering in oecd_query_dataset.

name.description: Concept name for the time dimension, repeating the id when no name was resolved.

title: Oecd Get Dataset Info
